• In gelatin from pig skin the transformation is partial, not complete, so foods, drinks and medicines containing it are not permissible (the answer cites the Standing Committee, 22/260, and fiqh council resolutions).
• Some researchers and the Islamic Organization for Medical Sciences considered it pure — so the matter is disputed.
